content: Keep this thought close at hand: What is evil? It is what you have seen many times before. Nothing in this world is new; all is familiar and ephemeral.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In Marcus Aurelius's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
